scientific_integrity: Proof derives exact nonnegative radial Jensen gap, a.e. radial linearization, quantitative coercivity and locally uniform three-scale limits. Numerical square checks are only diagnostics.
scientific_limitations: Only compact full-dimensional convex bodies with origin interior, n>=2; p tends to infinity for transition. Fixed-p claim is Peano order two at origin, not C2 on a neighborhood. No quantitative convergence rate uniform in K; potential unindexed prior all-convex extension remains.
title: Three covariogram scaling regimes without boundary smoothness
